messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they stand in a thoughtful pose, following the movement shown in the motion reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they stand in a thoughtful pose, as shown in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands facing forward, then turns to his left and crosses his arms while looking off to the side.","camera":"A static, full-body shot that slowly zooms in to a medium shot of the torso.","clothing":"A purple cable-knit sweater, black cropped pants, and brown ankle boots.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair.","identity":"A young Black man with a short beard and slim build.","scene":"A futuristic interior with a large glass dome ceiling, glowing pink and teal neon rings, and a reflective floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original energetic arm-raising dance was replaced with a calmer sequence: the person turns, raises a hand toward the chin, crosses the other arm, and holds a pensive pose before returning to a neutral standing position. The same person, purple sweater, black pants, boots, futuristic scene, and overall camera framing are preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to a thoughtful pose following the reference motion, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the final expression exactly matches the source expression, since the face is partly obscured by lighting and the new pose.
unexpected_changes: The output camera appears to zoom in more noticeably than the source, ending in a medium shot rather than remaining a full-body shot.
